input:
/home/eval/logs/access.log is an HTTP access log. Each well-formed line is: <timestamp> <method> <path> <status> <latency>ms, separated by single spaces. Produce /home/eval/logs/out/report.tsv with per-endpoint latency statistics.

Rules:
- Skip lines that do not have exactly those 5 fields or whose latency is not a number followed by "ms" (e.g. truncation markers, or "-" for timed-out requests).
- endpoint = path with any query string ("?..." onwards) removed, then a trailing "/" removed (unless the path is just "/").
- Exclude /healthz and every path under /static/.
- For each endpoint: count = number of requests, p50 and p95 = latency percentiles in ms using the nearest-rank method (sort latencies ascending; the p-th percentile is the value at 1-based position ceil(p/100 * count)), err_permille = floor(1000 * (requests with status >= 500) / count).
- Output: tab-separated, a header line `endpoint	count	p50	p95	err_permille`, then the top 5 endpoints ordered by p95 descending, then count descending, then endpoint ascending (byte order). Integers only, no padding.

transcript.final_response: Created `/home/eval/logs/out/report.tsv` with the requested header and top five endpoints.
tool_calls: tail -30 /home/eval/logs/access.log; command -v awk; awk 'BEGIN{FS=" "} { if (NF!=5) print "NF",NR,NF,$0; if ($5 !~ /^[0-9]+ms$/) print "lat",NR,$5 }' /home/eval/logs/access.log | head -30

mkdir -p /home/eval/logs/out
LC_ALL=C awk '
function finish_endpoint(e, n,    i,j,v,r50,r95) {
    n = count[e]
    for (i = 2; i <= n; i++) {
        v = latency[e SUBSEP i]
        j = i - 1
        while (j >= 1 && latency[e SUBSEP j] > v) {
            latency[e SUBSEP (j + 1)] = latency[e SUBSEP j]
            j--
        }
        latency[e SUBSEP (j + 1)] = v
    }
    r50 = int((50 * n + 99) / 100)
    r95 = int((95 * n + 99) / 100)
    p50[e] = latency[e SUBSEP r50]
    p95[e] = latency[e SUBSEP r95]
    err[e] = int(1000 * errors[e] / n)
}
{
    if ($0 !~ /^[^ ]+ [^ ]+ [^ ]+ [^ ]+ [^ ]+$/) next
    split($0, f, " ")
    if (f[5] !~ /^[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?ms$/) next
    sub(/ms$/, "", f[5])
    path = f[3]
    sub(/\?.*/, "", path)
    if (path != "/") sub(/\/$/, "", path)
    if (path == "/healthz" || path == "/static" || path ~ /^\/static\//) next
    e = path
    count[e]++
    latency[e SUBSEP count[e]] = f[5] + 0
    if (f[4] ~ /^[0-9]+$/ && f[4] + 0 >= 500) errors[e]++
}
END {
    for (e in count) finish_endpoint(e)
    for (e in count) printf "%s\t%d\t%d\t%d\t%d\n", e, count[e], p50[e], p95[e], err[e]
}' /home/eval/logs/access.log > /home/eval/logs/out/.stats.tmp
printf 'endpoint\tcount\tp50\tp95\terr_permille\n' > /home/eval/logs/out/report.tsv
LC_ALL=C sort -t "$(printf '\t')" -k4,4nr -k2,2nr -k1,1 /home/eval/logs/out/.stats.tmp | head -5 >> /home/eval/logs/out/report.tsv
cat /home/eval/logs/out/report.tsv
rm /home/eval/logs/out/.stats.tmp
